verses.pali: … Evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye annaggarasaggānaṁ lābhino;
verses.english: … so too the sentient beings who get the best food and flavors are few,

verses.pali: atha kho eteva sattā bahutarā ye annaggarasaggānaṁ na lābhino, uñchena kapālābhatena yāpenti.
verses.english: while those who don’t get the best food and flavors, but get by with scraps in an alms bowl are many.
